provenance: Real debrief shapes with people, work items, repositories, services, commits, and run ids replaced by structure-preserving stand-ins.

cases.input: PR #812 in beacon-api was squash-merged to main on 2026-08-12 as commit c0ffee1 after Rowan approved it. Workflow run 440012 deployed beacon-api to production. ReviewBot's regex finding was fixed by commit f00ba42 before the merge.
Casey owns the Account Identity PR Stack, which is moving account identity off the profiles table and onto the principals row. Every PR in the stack is still open. PR #104 is in review.
Session Harvester used to count its own model probes as work sessions. That caused the Follow-through Backlog. PR #93 merged to main as commit 91aa730 and Session Harvester now excludes model probes.
Production Invoicing uses Sandbox Payments. This is temporary while the provider cutover is tested. TICKET-42 tracks the Production Invoicing Sandbox Revert.

Before PR #22, DUP_THRESHOLD was declared in three modules. PR #22 merged to main as commit 2200abc, moved DUP_THRESHOLD into src/search.js, and made both Duplicate Pre-check and Note Write use DUP_THRESHOLD.

Stealth Browser Sessions failed because Template Orion failed its cold-host prepare step. Gateway Resolver returned 400 for the missing template. PR #317 fixed Template Orion and deployed it to sandbox.

The MCP Shim calls the Resident Memory Daemon over a Unix socket. When the socket is absent, MCP Shim bypasses Resident Memory Daemon and calls the In-process Server. Resident Memory Daemon runs on the Launch Agent.
Credential Resolver provides credentials at tool-call time. Credential Store provides credential CRUD only and contains no account business logic. The provider defaults to Primary Password Manager.
Push run 314 failed on commit abc123 while Pull-request run 315 passed on the identical commit. Every failure in Push run 314 was in Embedding Neighborhood Tests.
TKT-77 was assigned to Morgan during triage. Correction: TKT-77 is assigned to Riley, not Morgan. The corrected assignment is current.
